canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas; its chrome strip along the window top shows three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000/?assignee=Grace".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; the app content sits inside its white content area below the chrome strip.

layers.description: App header band across the top of the white content area: on the left the bold dark heading "Kanban board"; to its right a rounded dropdown select showing the highlighted dark label "Grace" with a small grey chevron, marked as the active filter; on the far right a rounded text input with grey placeholder text "Add a card…" followed by a blue rounded button with white label "Add".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the browser window content area, above the three board columns.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "To Do" at its top, holding exactly one plain white card row: the dark title "Fix login redirect", beside it a small rounded light-blue pill chip holding the dark label "Grace", and at the right edge two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete". The rest of the panel interior is empty.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Leftmost of three equal board columns arranged side by side with equal gaps; the row is drawn strictly inside this panel.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "In Progress" at its top, holding exactly one plain white card row: the dark title "Draft ADR-004", beside it a small rounded light-blue pill chip holding the dark label "Grace", and at the right edge two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete". The rest of the panel interior is empty.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Middle of the three equal board columns, between "To Do" on the left and "Done" on the right; the row is drawn strictly inside this panel.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "Done" at its top, holding no cards at all; in the vertical center of the panel interior a single line of muted grey italic text reads "Nothing for Grace here".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Rightmost of the three equal board columns; the empty-state text sits alone inside this panel.
